# Veqtor v0.4.2 Alpha

Veqtor is a local MCP server for verifiable Word negotiation evidence and tracked counterproposals.

This release adds exact clean-paragraph and table-cell edits, saved negotiation positions with explicit version confirmation and concurrency checks, and a repeated next-round workflow that restores positions and creates separate Word outputs with Track Changes. It also preserves controlled refusal codes across supported MCP transports.

The eleven-tool MCP surface is `veqtor.mcp.v0.4.2`. Existing document calls remain compatible with v0.4.0. Position stores are independent of the optional decision journal; older versions do not provide position tools. Rollback covers the extension runtime, not a downgrade or conversion of saved positions.

Use the wheel or sdist from this release, or install the exact version from PyPI. On macOS, the MCPB installs through Claude Desktop. Verify every asset using `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Acceptance uses an existing maintainer macOS user; it does not establish clean-install or developer-toolchain independence. Review final Word files before sending.

[Documentation](https://veqtor.pro/docs) · [Known limitations](https://veqtor.pro/limitations) · [Source](https://github.com/JohnDeer-ai/veqtor-mcp)
